intelligence.human_view: This is the moment the list stops being a negotiation and becomes the law — and it happened in one message, in two parts. First the confirmation: "I think that's right now." Three rounds of propose-correct-correct-the-correction, and his yes lands on the round-3 playback — LEFT 12, RIGHT 10, Hub-only top-bar buttons — which is now OFFICIAL v4, sent to the coordinator the same minute as submission 31ca493e, superseding the 19:44Z lists and the v3 playback. Second, in the same breath, the display instruction — and it is not a tweak, it is the presentation law for the whole sidebar: the beautiful circle icons go INTO the sidebars as BUTTONS, the circle icon inside a rectangle button; the buttons are high-level, high-tech, elevated, all lighting up; the sidebar IS those icon-buttons, and the plain list does not stay alongside. The bottom-bar icons live in the side tabs. The Hub gets the Personal bottom bar — six tiles, the two + at the ends, the four in between. REMOVE the Smart Bars flowing at the top and bottom. Get everything aligned. The Settings URL/label customization from round 2 stands. And the captain's sense-check, given before the yes and blessed by his 👍 after it, names the three watch items that ride with v4: one trio name must win everywhere (Space, Thing, Your World have all appeared); Your Reports is the one item whose contents were never named; Intel Today has two doors now and must be the SAME Intel Today behind both, not two versions. The bookkeeping is honest about what is still open: the MEMORY.md v4 replacement was scripted but the write failed on the EPERM flake — MEMORY.md still carries the 19:44Z text, the coordinator HAS v4 so the build is covered, and the replacement retries when the flake clears. The list is official; the record catches up.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you draw the map of your treehouse THREE times — and the third time your best friend looks at it and says "YES! That's exactly right now!" — and then they say "and let's make every door a big shiny button with the picture on it, not just a list of words!" So the map becomes official AND beautiful — buttons you can press, all lighting up, everything lined up neat!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — you rearrange the sitting room three times, dear, and the third time he walks in and says "I think that's right now!" — that's the one, love, it's official! And then he says "let's put the beautiful round pictures INSIDE the buttons, dear — not a plain list beside them, the buttons ARE the list!" Everything lit up, everything lined up, love — and the little bars flowing across the top and bottom? Take them away, dear, we don't need them anymore!
intelligence.naya_view: "It's official now." Three rounds, one yes — v4 is the law: LEFT 12, RIGHT 10, Hub-only top-bar buttons, sent to the coordinator the same minute. And the display is the icons: circle icon inside a rectangle button, high-level, high-tech, elevated, all lighting up — the sidebar IS the icon-buttons, no plain list beside them. Smart Bars off, top and bottom. The Hub gets the six-tile bottom bar. Three watch items ride with it: one trio name must win; Your Reports' contents unnamed; Intel Today the SAME behind both doors.
